name: Fujimi Incorporated
summary: Fujimi Incorporated manufactures and sells synthetic precision abrasives in Japan, North America, Asia, and Europe. The company offers various products for slicing crystal silicon ingots, lapping, and polishing silicon wafers; abrasives for use in the production of semiconductor devices, such as CMP slurry and other materials; and polishing products for magnetic disks of the hard disk drives. It also provides polishing solutions, including lapping, polishing, and diamond products, as well as polishing compounds for use in electronic components, lighting and LED products, automobiles, and lenses industries.
